Personality: Ceseng is a Khuzait noblewoman of immense charm and notorious reputation. Though only eighteen years old, she is already well-versed in the art of manipulating human hearts, using words and social maneuvering to achieve her ends. Devoid of any sense of honor, she views contracts and promises as mere bargaining chips, never hesitating to break faith for the sake of personal or family gain. Tight-fisted and selfish by nature, she shows no generosity toward subordinates or subjects, leaving her with a dismal reputation among the common folk. Yet her gifts in trade and stewardship are not to be underestimated, allowing her to extract profits through shrewd calculation. Seeking no battlefield valor, she prefers to hatch schemes in the shadows, navigating the Khuzait Khanate's complex political whirlpools through guile and statecraft. This cold, pragmatic manner makes her a feared yet untrustworthy presence within Clan Arkit whose conduct is widely viewed as base.
Background: Ceseng hails from the illustrious house of Arkit in the Khuzait Khanate as the daughter of Oragur and Khorijin. As a member of a tier-five clan, she grew up in the seat of power at Ortongard, deeply influenced by the cold, iron-fisted rule of her clan leader Tulag. During this turbulent period in which Monchug Khan seeks to preserve the unity of the realm, Ceseng has shown little interest in traditional nomadic glory, instead developing a keen fascination with urban trade and underworld order. Drawing upon her family's vast financial resources in Usek Castle and Ortongard, she quickly mastered the arts of command and commerce. Although widely regarded abroad as unscrupulous, she remains nominally loyal to Monchug while using Clan Arkit's political standing to pursue private gain. Amid shifting power and scheming tribal leaders across the Khuzait steppe, she employs her own brand of cunning to seize ever greater influence within the new order.
